description: ITEM 3: Chat table-stakes affordances on message bubbles - Copy, Regenerate, Edit-and-resend, and Stop-and-Continue. Copy-to-clipboard on each bubble (assistant + user). Regenerate re-runs the last assistant turn by re-sending the prior user message through the existing send path. Edit lets the user edit the last user message and re-send (regenerating from that point); deeper branching is deferred/noted. Continue: Stop already exists (stopGeneration, a validated no-op today per the composer comment - the pipeline has no cancel/resume seam); implement Continue as sending a follow-up 'continue' turn and NOTE the limitation rather than faking a resume. Display-safe, harbor-blue themed. Tests for copy (clipboard mocked), regenerate (invokes send with right content), edit-resend.
steps: Study the existing send path: frontend/src/state/conversations.ts sendMessage(content) delegates to send_message IPC and the reply streams via CoreEvents; messages are held in the store's `messages` array with role user/assistant. Regenerate/edit reuse this send path - there is no dedicated regenerate command, so implement them client-side over sendMessage against the existing conversation.

COPY: In frontend/src/features/chat/MessageBubble.tsx add a copy-to-clipboard button on every bubble (user + assistant) with an explicit aria-label 'Copy message' and harbor-blue themed styling. Copy the message's text content (for text messages; for tool/attachment content copy a sensible textual representation via the existing formatPayload helper). Use navigator.clipboard.writeText. Handle the copied-confirmation state locally (e.g. brief 'Copied' label) without breaking the streaming/error rendering.

REGENERATE: Add a Regenerate affordance on the LAST assistant message (or expose it via the bubble). Add a store action `regenerateLastTurn()` in conversations.ts that finds the most recent user message preceding the last assistant message and re-invokes sendMessage with that user message's content (re-running the turn). Keep it simple and correct: it appends a new turn via the existing send path (do NOT attempt to mutate/delete the prior assistant row unless the pipeline supports it - note that this produces a fresh turn rather than replacing in place, if that is the chosen mechanism). Document the exact mechanism chosen in findings.

EDIT: Add an edit affordance on the last USER message. Add a store action `editAndResend(messageId, newContent)` (or scope to the last user message) that re-sends the edited content through sendMessage. High-value case is editing the last user message + resend; note deeper branching (editing an arbitrary earlier message and truncating the tree) as deferred. Provide a small inline edit UI in MessageBubble for user messages (textarea + save/cancel) gated so it only applies where supported; harbor-blue themed with explicit aria-labels.

CONTINUE: In the composer or on the last assistant bubble, add a 'Continue' affordance. Implement it as sending a follow-up turn with content like 'continue' (or 'Please continue.') through sendMessage, since the Phase-4 pipeline has NO resume seam (the composer already documents stop_generation as a validated no-op). Add a visible note/comment that this is a follow-up turn, not a true resume, matching the honest-affordance convention already used for Stop. Do NOT fake a resume.

Wire affordances into the UI where they belong: per-message buttons in MessageBubble (copy on all; edit on last user; regenerate on last assistant) and/or a small action row. Ensure they are display-safe and do not appear while a message is streaming where that would be incoherent (e.g. no regenerate mid-stream). Reuse existing streaming/disabled patterns from the composer.
STYLES: add harbor-blue themed styles for the new bubble action buttons and inline edit UI in frontend/src/styles/app.css using existing tokens (light + dark).

TESTS (frontend, all invoke mocked with well-formed shapes): (a) Copy - mock navigator.clipboard.writeText and assert clicking Copy calls it with the message text. (b) Regenerate - assert regenerateLastTurn invokes send_message with the correct prior user content. (c) Edit-resend - assert editing the last user message and saving invokes send_message with the edited content. (d) Continue - assert it invokes send_message with the follow-up content. Ensure every test mounting chat/App mocks send_message, get_messages, list_available_models {models,errors}, provider_diagnostics, create_conversation, list/create_persona, and the web-search/network/attach/repo commands with well-formed shapes, and initializes any new store fields in resets.

Run the offline self-audit: whole-frontend `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .`; static review for eslint no-unused-vars / tsc-strict / aria-labels; per-crate cargo fmt --check only if any Rust was touched (this feature is expected to be frontend-only). Record verified-live vs CI-only in findings.
acceptance_criteria: Every message bubble (user + assistant) has a Copy button (aria-label 'Copy message') that writes the message text to the clipboard.
A Regenerate affordance on the last assistant turn re-invokes the send path with the prior user message content; the mechanism is documented in findings.
An Edit affordance on the last user message lets the user edit and re-send via the send path; deeper branching is explicitly noted as deferred.
A Continue affordance sends a follow-up 'continue' turn and is documented as a follow-up (not a true resume), with the pipeline's no-resume-seam limitation noted.
Tests cover copy (clipboard mocked), regenerate (send invoked with right content), edit-resend, and continue; all pass under vitest.
New buttons/inputs are harbor-blue themed with explicit aria-labels and do not regress streaming/error rendering.
verification: From hybrid-orchestrator/frontend run `npm test` and confirm the copy/regenerate/edit/continue tests pass and no existing chat tests regress (or record CI-only).
Run `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` clean over the whole frontend dir (or CI-only).
Static-confirm affordances are display-safe and coherent with streaming state (no regenerate mid-stream, etc.).
findings:
FRONTEND-ONLY change (no Rust touched). Files: MessageBubble.tsx (copy/edit/regenerate/continue affordances + inline edit UI), MessageList.tsx (passes isLastUser/isLastAssistant), conversations.ts (regenerateLastTurn/editAndResend/continueTurn actions), app.css (harbor-blue themed .message-bubble__actions/__action/__edit styles, light+dark via existing tokens), plus chat.test.tsx and conversations.test.ts.

REGENERATE MECHANISM: FRESH TURN, not in-place replace. regenerateLastTurn() finds the last assistant message, walks back to the most recent preceding USER message, and re-invokes the existing sendMessage(content) with that user text. It does NOT mutate/delete the prior assistant row - there is no dedicated regenerate command and the Phase-4 pipeline has no in-place-replace seam, so an honest appended turn is the correct affordance. No-op when there is no active conversation or no preceding user message, or the prior user content is non-text.

EDIT SCOPE: only the LAST user message is editable (high-value case). editAndResend(messageId, newContent) verifies messageId is the last user message (via role lastIndexOf) and, if so, re-sends the trimmed edited content through sendMessage as a fresh turn; a non-last id or empty content is a no-op. DEFERRED: editing an arbitrary earlier message and truncating/branching the conversation tree from that point - the pipeline has no truncate/branch seam, so like regenerate it appends rather than rewriting history. Inline edit UI is a textarea (aria-label 'Edit message') + Save & resend (aria-label 'Save edited message') + Cancel (aria-label 'Cancel edit') buttons in the bubble, gated to the last user message and hidden while streaming.

CONTINUE: implemented as an HONEST FOLLOW-UP TURN, not a resume. continueTurn() sends 'Please continue.' through sendMessage. The button carries title 'Sends a follow-up 'continue' turn (not a true resume)' and a code comment noting the pipeline has NO cancel/resume seam (the same reason stopGeneration is a validated no-op), matching the existing honest-affordance convention for Stop. LIMITATION: there is no partial generation to resume; the model is simply asked to continue in a new turn.

DISPLAY-SAFE: Copy (aria-label 'Copy message', navigator.clipboard.writeText, brief 'Copied' label via a 1.5s local timer, best-effort try/catch) is on EVERY bubble (user + assistant, all content types via a contentToText helper reusing formatPayload). Edit/Regenerate/Continue are shown only when the message is settled (!streaming) so no regenerate/continue can fire mid-stream. FEAT-003 Reasoning section and the streaming/error rendering paths are preserved unchanged.

VERIFICATION: STATIC-ONLY / CI-ONLY. The sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY with NO node/npm/npx and no node_modules (confirmed: `which npm node npx` -> none, node_modules absent), so `npm test` (vitest), `tsc`, eslint, and `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` could NOT be run here - same constraint FEAT-002/FEAT-003 recorded. Did a rigorous static self-audit instead: (a) all new store fields already existed / no new store fields added, so existing setState resets in both test files remain complete (they already reset webSearchEnabled + thinkingEnabled); (b) new tests mock invoke for send_message and get_messages with well-formed shapes and clipboard is mocked via Object.assign(navigator,{clipboard:{writeText}}); (c) no unused imports/vars (useState used; all three store actions consumed); (d) tsc-strict: MessageContent switch in contentToText is exhaustive (all 4 variants return), Role union makes lastIndexOf type-safe, optional props typed; (e) new buttons/inputs all have explicit aria-labels; (f) prettier: matched printWidth 100 / double quotes / semicolons / trailingComma all / 2-space indent by hand - the only >100 lines are it("...") test-title strings, which prettier does not break (consistent with the many pre-existing long test titles); (g) chained JSX ternary (editing ? : isTextError ? : ) uses prettier's same-level format. Real gates (eslint/tsc/vitest/prettier) will run in GitHub CI after push. cargo fmt --check not applicable (no Rust touched).
